description: This file defines the ParamsMiddleware class, which handles parameter processing and user authentication for API requests within the Api\V8\Middleware namespace. It manages request parameters, sets the current user based on OAuth tokens, and handles exceptions by returning error responses.

classes.name: ParamsMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for processing request parameters and setting the current user based on OAuth tokens, with error handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with parameter and bean manager instances.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles the middleware invocation, processes parameters, sets current user, and manages exceptions.

methods.name: setCurrentUserGlobal
methods.description: Retrieves OAuth token, fetches user, and sets the global current user if enabled.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Collects and merges route, query, and body parameters from the request.
